title: Universal Front Door
equation: Customer Entry = Clear Offer × Low Friction × High Perceived Value
hook: People want to buy from you. They just can't figure out where to start.
statement: A business grows faster with one clear, high-value entry offer that brings the right people in.
explainer: Your front door could be a free trial, a cheap starter offer, a template, or a quick call. When the first step is obvious and easy, strangers walk in instead of bouncing.
sop: Find your ideal customer's easiest first yes.
Make that entry offer valuable and low-friction.
Connect it to your deeper paid offers.
Score Clear Offer, Low Friction, and High Perceived Value from 1 to 10.
Fix the front door before building more entrances.
equation_example: Clear Offer 8, Low Friction 9, High Perceived Value 6. 8 × 9 × 6 = 432 Customer Entry, out of 1,000. Higher means strangers step in almost on their own. Lower means people leave before they ever see your value.
question: Write down the one obvious first step a new person should take with your business.
